comment: Hand-edited list of Critical Dates for the Current Schedule page. Past items are dropped daily by tools/schedule/build_schedule.py. Unlike other events, Critical Dates are shown even when they fall more than 60 days out. Times are Mountain Time. designated_by is 'standing' for verified recurring constitutional or official-calendar items, or the name of the person who added a one-off item. Set unverified to true when the date is listed pending a posted notice. Set tentative to true when the official source marks the date as tentative or subject to change.
notes: The End of Session date is from the official tentative 2027 General Session schedule (convenes January 12; last day March 10). Update the item if a later official calendar is posted.
